title: KVUse: Reusable-KV User Memory for Efficient LLM Recommenders
abstract: arXiv:2611.21920v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Memory-augmented recommenders built on large language models (LLMs) maintain a natural-language profile of each user. These profiles are updated by a user profile update path that revises the profile as new interactions arrive and are consumed by downstream task paths like ranking. Because these user profiles are stored as text in the user memory, every ranking LLM call that consumes them must splice them in the prompt and calculate the KV cache of them during the prefill phase. Prefix caching cannot remove it, because these user profiles are preceded by different text in different calls. translated_title: KVUse：面向高效LLM推荐系统的可复用KV用户记忆
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的记忆增强推荐系统为每个用户维护一份自然语言形式的用户画像。这些画像由用户画像更新路径随着新交互的到来不断修订，并被排序等下游任务路径所消费。由于这些用户画像以文本形式存储在用户记忆中，每一次消费它们的排序LLM调用都必须将其拼接进提示词（prompt）中，并在预填充（prefill）阶段为其计算KV缓存。鉴于这些排序LLM调用是预填充密集型的（提示词很长但解码输出很短）且被反复调用，这种对用户画像文本的重复预填充主导了整个服务开销。前缀缓存无法消除这一开销，因为在不同调用中，用户画像前面拼接的是不同的文本。我们提出KVUse，它将用户画像以可复用的键值（KV）缓存形式而非文本形式存储。KVUse通过自蒸馏训练轻量级的LoRA写入器，使得用户画像……
tldr: KVUse提出将LLM推荐系统中的用户画像以可复用的KV缓存而非文本形式存储，并通过自蒸馏训练轻量级LoRA写入器来生成这些KV缓存，从而消除排序调用中对用户画像文本的重复预填充开销，显著提升LLM推荐系统的服务效率。
en_tdlr: KVUse stores user profiles in LLM-based recommenders as reusable KV caches instead of text, training lightweight LoRA writers via self-distillation to generate them, thereby eliminating the repeated prefill of user profile text and significantly improving serving efficiency.
